name: Rakshasa
summary: A fiend highly resistant to magic that curses with its touch, issues baleful commands, and casts spells.

vulnerabilities: Piercing damage from weapons wielded by creatures under the effect of a Bless spell

traits.name: Greater Magic Resistance
traits.text: The rakshasa automatically succeeds on saving throws against spells and other magical effects, and the attack rolls of spells automatically miss it. Without the rakshasa's permission, no spell can observe the rakshasa remotely or detect its thoughts, creature type, or alignment.

traits.name: Fiendish Restoration
traits.text: If the rakshasa dies outside the Nine Hells, its body turns to ichor, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its {ref:glossary/hit-points} somewhere in the Nine Hells.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The rakshasa makes three Cursed Touch attacks.

actions.name: Cursed Touch
actions.onHit: If the target is a creature, it is cursed. While cursed, the target gains no benefit from finishing a Short or {ref:glossary/long-rest}.

actions.name: Baleful Command

save.targets: each enemy in a 30-foot Emanation originating from the rakshasa

actions.onFailure: and the target has the {ref:condition/frightened} and {ref:condition/incapacitated} conditions until the start of the rakshasa's next turn.
